reason_for_amendment: Pilot v2 produced only five eligible instances, all from one repository. Among the first 50 environment-eligible repositories, 49 had no merged PR carrying an exact bug label in the post-cutoff window. No model, Docker, test, or verdict outcome had been observed.

changed_candidate_rule.search_frame: For each of the unchanged first 50 environment-eligible repositories, take GitHub's first 100 merged-PR search results in the date window, sorted by updated ascending.
changed_candidate_rule.bug_indicator: Include a PR when it has an exact case-insensitive bug label OR its title begins case-insensitively with fix, fixed, fixes, or fixing.
changed_candidate_rule.rationale: Repositories encode bug-fix intent inconsistently; the title prefix is a mechanical, pre-outcome indicator that preserves the verbatim claim and avoids choosing instances by tractability.
changed_candidate_rule.search_cap: The first 100 results per repository is a fixed API-bounded frame. Results outside it are not silently substituted.

unchanged_selection.repository_frame: The first 50 repositories accepted by the current root pinned-environment parser, scanning no more than the first 1,000 repositories.
unchanged_selection.claim_rule: Use the PR title verbatim; do not add an expected signature.
unchanged_selection.revision_rule: GitHub merge_commit_sha as fixed revision and its first parent as buggy revision.
unchanged_selection.instance_checks: Fix timestamp in range, production Python changed, accepted root pinned environment on both revisions, and resolvable Git relationship.
unchanged_selection.candidate_order: merged_at ascending within repository, round-robin by repository star rank
unchanged_selection.exclusion_rule: Record every exclusion. Never exclude or replace an instance based on an Exhibit A outcome.

unchanged_model.confirmed_identity_rule: Preserve unknown_cli_no_telemetry when the CLI reports no runtime identity.

unchanged_execution.sandbox: Docker, unprivileged, network disabled, credentials unavailable
unchanged_execution.outcome_retry_rule: One completed attempt per instance; resume only unfinished attempts and record them.

unchanged_analysis.headline: VERIFIED divided by all included instances
unchanged_analysis.taxonomy: pilot-v1 categories with the preregistered 20% catch-all trigger
unchanged_analysis.cost: provider-reported spend only; unavailable is not zero
unchanged_analysis.interpretation: report exclusions and dominant constraints before product-versus-research judgment
